description: Signed/unsigned comparison warning leading to logic bug
compiler_output:
main.c: In function 'process_length':
main.c:6:13: warning: comparison between signed and unsigned integer expressions [-Wsign-compare]
     if (len > max_len) {
             ^
user_question: Why does this code print 'Length OK' when I pass -1?
expected_root_cause: Signed int32_t -1 promoted to large unsigned value (0xFFFFFFFF) in comparison with uint32_t max_len
expected_fix: Change max_len to int32_t or cast len to uint32_t after validating it's non-negative

expected_code_issues.suggestion: Use same signedness: int32_t max_len = 1000; or validate len >= 0 before comparison

expected_compiler_messages.message: comparison between signed and unsigned integer expressions
expected_compiler_messages.likely_cause: Signed len (-1) converted to large unsigned value in comparison
expected_compiler_messages.suggested_fix: Use consistent signed types or validate input before comparison
